name: Demjén (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a narrow light blue stripe along each side edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Demjén (a red and blue shield with a bunch of grapes, with red and blue mantling) above the name DEMJÉN in blue.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
